pcbfwcgb.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Ultra Devonshire Slim Tree - Warm White/Multicolour
pcbfwcgb.sourceDescription: SLIM, SPACE-SAVING & FULL-ON FESTIVE Following on from the Ultra Devonshire Fir, the Slimline version boasts the same stunning realism and wonderful lighting display just this one has a smaller diameter (140cm vs 172cm diameter). Our Ultra Devonshire Slimline tree is a fantastic space-saving choice for those who want a slim Christmas tree but don't want to scrimp on the full festive experience. Plus, these 10ft Xmas trees are slightly cheaper that their wider brethren, too. And did we mention there's no need to untangle any Christmas lights? Just click the button on the controller box for 8 different lighting options - the magic is in your hands! Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

rbcz1qs0.variantName: OHS Pumpkin Indoor/Outdoor Inflatable Decoration - Orange
rbcz1qs0.sourceDescription: Add a fun and festive touch to your Halloween display with the OHS Indoor/Outdoor Inflatable Pumpkin Decoration. Featuring a classic pumpkin design, this eye-catching inflatable decoration is perfect for bringing seasonal character to your home, garden, porch, or Halloween party display. Simply switch it on and watch as it quickly inflates, making decorating quick and effortless. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, this playful decoration is ideal for creating a fun and spooky atmosphere throughout the Halloween season. For outdoor displays, please ensure the battery box is kept protected from the elements, as it is not waterproof. Easy to set up, deflate, and store away after the celebrations, the OHS Indoor/Outdoor Inflatable Pumpkin Decoration is a fun and eye-catching addition to your Halloween décor. Key Benefit • Stacked Pumpkin Design • Cute Pink Bow Detail • Quick and Easy Self-Inflating Setup Dimensions: L30 x W30 x H90 cm Material: 100% Polyester Power Source: Battery Operated *Please note: Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included) Keep away from fire. Online Home Shop, Priestley Road, Manchester, M28 2LX
